propositions: AC acceptance criteria with operational-evidence markers (deploy, prod, live-run, IaC-apply, merge-gate, etc.) that lack [operator-attested] tag are not detected at plan time, causing verify failures requiring retroactive tagging (tickets 115b, 8c4f)

A deterministic lexicon-based advisory lint is needed to flag untagged operational-evidence AC items before claim, integrated into p6_ac_quality without blocking and without modifying routing or DET_CHECKS cardinality
The [operator-attested] tag matcher must be single-sourced between the plan-time lint and the completion-verifier enrichment path to ensure they agree on what constitutes a tagged item

The lint must achieve ≥70% precision on a ≥50-item sample, ≤5% overall flag rate, and successfully detect both known cases (115b and 8c4f) when their tags are stripped, validated against a frozen historical AC corpus before activation
The eval harness and results must be committed before the lint activation to establish deterministic self-gate criteria independent of any LLM inference
